traits.name: Structural Form
traits.descriptionHtml:
The living city can spend 10 minutes in Concentration to shape-shift into a Gargantuan structure or back into its true, amorphous form. Its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

While in the form of a structure, the living city takes up its entire space and creates floors, walls, doorways, and windows within its space which resemble and behave like normal structures, while leaving behind open space within it to create rooms. Creatures can pass through the open spaces and stop there as if moving through a normal structure.

The walls and floors of the living city can be damaged and thus breached. Each 5-foot-by-5-foot section has AC 15 and 30 Hit Points. Reducing a section to 0 Hit Points destroys it and deals 30 damage to the living city. A living city can only take this damage once per turn.

In addition, the living city extrudes pieces of itself inside its space which resemble furnishings and everyday objects. The extrusions appear, feel, sound, and behave exactly like the mimicked objects. A thin, slimy tendril connects any furnishings or objects to the body of the living city. The tendril has AC 15 and 1 Hit Points. If the tether is severed or destroyed, the simulacra melts into goo, but does no harm to the living city.

Instead, the ravenous flora takes one of the following Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn:

    Melee Attack: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition and the ravenous flora can't Bite another target.

  • Spit Acid.

    Ranged Attack: +7, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (2d4 Acid). While Burning, the target has the Blinded condition.

  • Swallow.

    The ravenous flora makes one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it has Grappled. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed and the grapple ends. The swallowed target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Cover from attacks and effects outside the flora, and takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The flora can have up to four targets swallowed at a time.

    If the flora takes 15 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land with the Prone condition in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of it. If the flora dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

While uncontrolled, the leg forces the target to move up to its Speed in a random direction at the start of its turn. actions.name: Devour
actions.descriptionHtml:
The World Ender can't take this Epic Action if it has used its Bite Epic Action this round. The World ender makes a Bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it has Grappled. If the attack hits, the target takes the Bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, it has Cover against effects originating from outside the World Ender, and it takes 56 (16d6) Acid damage and gains a Contamination level at the start of each of the World Ender's turns.

If the World Ender takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the World Ender must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of the World Ender with the Prone condition. If the World Ender dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Unbind Gravity (1/Round)
actions.descriptionHtml:
The Think Tank controls gravity in a 200-foot Cube [Area of Effect] centered on itself until the end of the next round. Each time the Think Tank uses this Epic Action, it decides which direction gravity pulls within the area. All creatures and objects that aren't somehow anchored to the ground in the area fall in the chosen direction until they reach the edge of the area. A creature can make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, avoiding the fall on a success.

If some solid object (such as a ceiling) is encountered in this fall, falling objects and creatures strike it just as they would during a normal downward fall. If an object or creature reaches the edge of the area without striking anything, it remains there, oscillating slightly, for the duration.

Alternatively, the Think Tank can decide to prevent gravity from acting within the area. When it does, creatures within the area without a Fly Speed levitate in midair, and must move by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows them to move as if they were climbing. Unattended objects float around randomly.

If the Think Tank doesn't use this Epic Action during the next round, the effect ends and affected objects and creatures fall back down.

If some solid object (such as a ceiling) is encountered in this fall, falling objects and creatures strike it just as they would during a normal downward fall. If an object or creature reaches the edge of the area without striking anything, it remains there, oscillating slightly, for the duration.

Alternatively, the Think Tank can decide to prevent gravity from acting within the area. When it does, creatures within the area without a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} levitate in midair, and must move by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows them to move as if they were climbing. Unattended objects float around randomly.
If the Think Tank doesn't use this {@variantrule Epic Action|MonstersOfDrakkenheim} during the next round, the effect ends and affected objects and creatures fall back down.

Anything it swallows is transported into this extraplanar space, which manifests as a rhizomatic network of slurping tunnels and fleshy passages. On a success, it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of the warp marauder. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. If the warp marauder dies, everything inside the extraplanar gullet appears in the nearest unoccupied spaces to its corpse.

entries: When the zealot would fail a saving throw, it can reroll the save with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}. It must use the new roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The zealot makes two Greatsword attacks.
entries: The zealot makes two Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Attack: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Radiant damage.

bonusActions.name: For the Flame (1/Day)
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Allies of the zealot within 60 feet of it that can hear it gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of the zealot's next turn.
entries: Allies of the zealot within 60 feet of it that can hear it gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of the zealot's next turn.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.descriptionHtml: The vampire has Advantage on melee attack rolls against a creature with the Bloodied condition.
entries: The vampire has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on melee attack rolls against a creature with the {@status Bloodied|XPHB} condition.

traits.name: Blood Shield
traits.descriptionHtml: Whenever the vampire damages a creature that has blood, the vampire gains 15 Temporary Hit Points.
entries: Whenever the vampire damages a creature that has blood, the vampire gains 15 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.descriptionHtml: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Points and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.
entries: The vampire regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.descriptionHtml: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
entries: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.descriptionHtml: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.
entries: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Bite.
entries: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.descriptionHtml: Melee Attack: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 21).
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d4 + 5}) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 21}).

macro.targets: and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 21})

actions.name: Bite
actions.descriptionHtml: con DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. {@actSaveFail} 15 (3d6 + 5) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Points Maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount.
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} Maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to that amount.

bonusActions.name: Morrigan's Fury (1/Short Rest)
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: The vampire howls at the moon, gaining Resistance to all damage except Acid and Radiant damage for 1 minute or until it has the Incapacitated condition. As part of this Bonus Action, the vampire moves up to half its Speed toward a Hostile [Attitude] creature without provoking Opportunity Attack action.
entries: The vampire howls at the moon, gaining {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage except Acid and Radiant damage for 1 minute or until it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. As part of this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, the vampire moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} toward a {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} action.
